name: SMASH 2000L rifle fire control
description: Computerized rifle sight for dismounted counter-drone fire. Group 1 quads inside 250 m.

maxRangeM.condition: small UAS kinetic elimination up to 200 m in day mode

dispersionMils.note: Planning factor: the 5.56 mm carbine and its M855 round, not the sight, set the round-to-round dispersion; 1.0 mil at 1 sigma is the planning value. Smart Shooter publishes a hit probability, not a dispersion.

fireControlErrorMils.note: Planning factor: the SMASH sight releases the shot only when the computed aim sits on the locked target, so the residual aim error is small next to the ballistic dispersion; 0.5 mil at 1 sigma is the planning value. The vendor claims about 95 percent first-round hit and publishes no error.

burstRounds.note: Planning factor: the SMASH engagement is one aimed, computer-released shot on a locked target, so the burst is a single round. Automatic fire from the host rifle is not the engagement mode.

rateOfFireRpm.condition: host M4A1 carbine cyclic rate of 700 to 970 rounds/min; the midpoint is taken, and the SMASH engagement is single aimed shots rather than automatic fire
rateOfFireRpm.source: M4 carbine open reference, quoted from the search index; the page was not opened

muzzleVelocityMps.condition: M855 from the 14.5 in M4A1 barrel, 2,887 ft/s (880 m/s); the SMASH sight mounts on the host rifle and does not change the round
muzzleVelocityMps.source: M4 carbine open reference, quoted from the search index; the page was not opened
